name: Harken Windtotem
summary: In Bloodhoof Village, Harken Windtotem guides young hunters across Mulgore’s plains. He teaches the traditions of his people and asks hunters and travelers to prove their tracking and foraging skills.

sections.title: Huntsman of Bloodhoof
sections.body: Near the heart of Bloodhoof Village, Harken Windtotem guides those learning the tauren hunting ways. Life on Mulgore’s plains calls for respect for the natural world and the skills needed to sustain a tribe. Harken tests young hunters by sending them after the swoops that circle the mesas. They gather the birds’ quills, showing patience, aim, and care in taking only what they need.

faq.answer: Harken Windtotem is a tauren huntsman in Bloodhoof Village, where he guides travelers and young hunters in the tracking and hunting traditions of the tauren.

faq.q: Where can Harken Windtotem be found?
faq.answer: Harken Windtotem can be found in Bloodhoof Village, south of Thunder Bluff in central Mulgore.

faq.q: What tasks does Harken give to adventurers?
faq.answer: Harken Windtotem sends hunters into Mulgore’s grasslands to hunt wild swoops and gather their sturdy flight quills.

faq.q: Is Harken related to Bovan Windtotem?
faq.answer: Harken Windtotem and Bovan Windtotem share a clan name, suggesting a tribal kinship or family connection. Harken focuses on local hunts in Mulgore.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can see Harken Windtotem’s respect for the ancestral ways of hunting: discipline and self-sufficiency on the plains, with honor for the beasts of the Earth Mother.
As a hunter passing through Bloodhoof Village, you can test your marksmanship and gathering skills by bringing down airborne swoops.
